about.title: Manteca Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a death in Manteca comes suddenly, the paperwork arrives before the grief has room to settle. In 2025, public records show 283 injury collisions in the city, 411 people hurt, and 2 lives lost on local roads, with reported crashes clustering on Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. along corridors like SR-120, Yosemite Avenue, SR-99 and Main Street. California gives a spouse or domestic partner and children the first right to bring a wrongful death claim, with certain dependents and heirs able to step in when no one in that group exists. The claim is civil and moves separately from any criminal case tied to the same event. Families generally have two years from the date of death to file, and far less time when a public agency may share responsibility. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We connect Manteca families with an independent attorney who works on contingency, so asking questions does not add another bill.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on SR-120 near Manteca. Is a wrongful death claim different from the criminal case?
items.answer: Yes. A wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family, while any criminal charges are pursued by the state. The two proceed on separate tracks, and a civil claim can move forward whether or not charges are filed. An attorney can explain how the police report from San Joaquin County fits into your claim.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The law gives first priority to the surviving spouse or domestic partner and the children. If none of those relatives exist, certain financially dependent family members or heirs may be able to file instead. Standing rules can get complicated in blended families, so it is worth having an attorney review your specific situation.

items.question: How long do we have to act, and what does it cost to find out?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death lawsuit, but claims involving a government entity require a formal notice much sooner. LawProactive is free to use and is not a law firm. The independent attorneys we connect you with work on contingency, meaning there is no fee unless there is a recovery.
